title: console: the permission-set editor keeps the clone notice "The copy is held by nobody yet" after users are assigned and the copy is saved
body:
Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2207, the maintainer's browser round on ObjectStack 18.0.0 (「hotcrm 升级到 objectstack 18.0 然后重新安排一轮浏览器测试」). Each defect gets its own card, by the maintainer's ruling 「按照按照具体的issue单独提交卡片，不受数量限制。」 (recorded on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, `6283467378`). This is finding **F-06** of track 2 (the Setup pass as the system administrator), by the cloud tester `session_01BkRPwuAufrFwoEEfuigDm9`. It was measured on HotCRM `main` `16c28664` with `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0 (framework `06cab4849`, console objectui `616df6598b42`), in Chromium at 1440×900 on a locally booted, seeded install. The evidence is on the branch `claude/qa-v18-setup-pass` at `4d7cc467d` ([`REPORT.md`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/4d7cc467dcb08226fea5b8a1b2ea89ee05d6353b/qa/2026-10-20-v18-setup/REPORT.md)), which is never merged. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 2 (`os-support-ai`, session `session_01KqkTQNLcxVc588eZpJmp1r`). ⛔ Not a claim. Grade: triage's.

**Reader (who acts):** objectui triage routes it.

## The finding, as measured

- **Persona / URL:** dev admin, `/apps/setup/metadata/permission/qa_fls_rep`, made by **Clone to customize** from `sales_rep`.
- **Steps:** Assigned Users → Add user (QA Position) → Confirm (`201`); change a field override; Save (`200`).
- **Expected:** the banner reflects the state. Its own last sentence is a call to act: "The copy is held by nobody yet: add it to a position, or assign it to users."
- **Actual:** the banner stays, unchanged, after the assignment and after Save, while the panel below it reads "Assigned Users 1 — QA Position, direct", and that user reads accounts through the set.
- **Evidence:** [`14-access-permission-sets-cloned.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/4d7cc467dcb08226fea5b8a1b2ea89ee05d6353b/qa/2026-10-20-v18-setup/shots/14-access-permission-sets-cloned.png), [`14-access-permission-sets-fls-saved.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/4d7cc467dcb08226fea5b8a1b2ea89ee05d6353b/qa/2026-10-20-v18-setup/shots/14-access-permission-sets-fls-saved.png).
- **Reach:** admins who clone a permission set.

## Seat review (source at the console pin `616df6598b42`)

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx`:
  - stores the clone result on `onCloned` (`:1226`, `setCloned(copy)`);
  - keeps it for as long as the copy is the open set, across every reload (`:685`);
  - renders the server's notice verbatim from it (`:1414`).
- Nothing clears it on an assignment or a save.
- The sentence is a point-in-time server notice (objectstack `packages/runtime/src/domains/permission-set-clone.ts:121`), so the editor is what makes it stale.
- Not verified: the tester's "it re-appears as a toast on Save". The editor makes no toast call, and the saved-state screenshot shows no toast.
- The only commit to the file after the pin (`c8833c5b8d`, unsaved-edit prompts) does not touch this.

## Dedupe

Method: every objectstack-ai/objectstack issue title (every state, #1–#24932) and every objectstack-ai/objectui issue title (#7–#13268), listed through the repo-scoped `issues?state=all` endpoint (refreshed with `since=2026-10-19`) and matched case-insensitively. The search API is refused for this session.
- Related, closed: objectui#5987 (introduced Clone to customize and this banner).
- Different: objectstack#24327 (the notice's wording); objectui#12164 (the clone door).
- **New.**
